image_description: A slice of meatloaf served on a black plastic compartmentalized tray. The meatloaf slice has a browned, textured exterior and a dense interior with visible flecks of ingredients. To the left is a white paper cup containing what appears to be beans or chili, with red text on the side. To the right are small portions of broccoli and cauliflower. The background shows a patterned green tablecloth.
